answer: An operator copying one text across 163 aliases therefore forfeits for 163 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the knoll hash is stored at intake, the haven graph groups the endorsements and the sparrow audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
